researchHypothesis.primaryIdea: Trade only after a defined session opening range forms, then enter either confirmed ORB continuation or fakeout/VWAP reclaim/rejection.
whyDifferentFromFailedScalper: Does not use EMA pullback as the main edge
Uses a defined intraday event: opening range, breakout, fakeout, VWAP reclaim or rejection
Limits trades per session and per day
Starts with liquid symbols only: BTC, ETH, SOL
riskControls: one trade per session per symbol

knownProblems: Session definitions may overfit to the tested date range
Crypto trades 24/7 so session windows are less clean than equity market opens
False breakouts can remain frequent without good confirmation filters
VWAP can lag during sharp liquidation or news moves
Backtest has not been run yet in this branch
blockedChanges: Do not add Session ORB VWAP to Railway paper loop yet
Do not use OKX API keys
Do not use martingale or increase position size after losses
Do not expand to illiquid altcoins before BTC/ETH/SOL show edge

successCriteriaForFirstPass.minimumTrades: at least 30-80 trades preferred, but fewer is acceptable if multiple sessions/symbols are represented
successCriteriaForFirstPass.tradesPerDay: low frequency preferred, ideally below 10 across the tested basket
successCriteriaForFirstPass.drawdown: controlled and acceptable relative to 1000 USDT paper balance
successCriteriaForFirstPass.grossPnlBeforeFees: must be positive; otherwise the strategy has no directional edge
successCriteriaForFirstPass.symbolDiversification: result should not depend on one symbol only
successCriteriaForFirstPass.paperLoopDecision: if edge disappears after fees/slippage or only one scenario/symbol works by chance, do not add to paper loop
